Did you know? You can right-click anywhere on this page to get some quick actions
You can right-click an asset's name in a list and choose "Rename". This allows you to quickly rename your asset. Press "Enter" to save.
Right-click your username in the navigation to quickly access your settings
YouTube thumbnails should be 1280x720 in size
YouTube has a 100 character limit for video titles, though most names will be cut short to 70 characters in search results
Having more information and a bunch of links in your video description helps you get recommended more
People interacting with your videos, like liking and commenting, helps you get recommended more and even land on trending. User interaction is very important.
Did you know? Once you've added a YouTube video to this site, you can change it's channel at any time it the video's settings
Live-streaming on YouTube can be a good way to increase channel watch-time
Every uploaded asset has a batch attached to it, but it is hidden when only one file is in a batch. To access the batch, click on the "Batch Size" number when viewing an asset
When viewing a batch, you'll see a bunch of information about the assets. This is all sourced from the first asset in the batch.

Classical music can get you a copyright-strike on YouTube even if it's copyright expired already. This is because some recordings of classical songs are copyrighted by the orchestra that performed it.
When uploading an asset, make sure that all of the given information, especially licence information, are filled out correctly
Songs that disallow commercial-use cannot be used on YouTube, regardless of if you actually earn money from those videos
Make sure to tag your YouTube videos well, and include a lot of information in your video description
The YouTube description limit is 5,000 characters
You can hover over the favorite button on any asset to check when you favorited it.
